688:t_3:349.en:
$n
「My battles were all engineered by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and this one...」

688:t_3:350.en:
$n
「Even so, I... we have no choice but to fight.」

688:t_3:351.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Now that's a warrior who has transcended hope and despair! Infinite possibilities beyond even my calculations and expectations!」

688:t_3:354.en:
$$宗介$$
「I had heard the rumors, but the unpleasantness of this man... is intolerable.」

688:t_3:355.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-yeah... He's just creepy, no matter how you look at it...」

688:t_3:356.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To think a person like this was hiding inside $c...」

688:t_3:357.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not thinking of people as people... that's no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

688:t_3:358.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「W-wait! If we just talk, you'll understand!」

688:t_3:359.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't expect anyone to trust a man who secretly planted suggestions akin to mind control.」

688:t_3:360.en:
$$カレン$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ is just as bad! Letting a guy like this talk him around!」

688:t_3:361.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I apologize for going ahead without telling you. And for my methods as well.」

688:t_3:362.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, you... were like this back in the $$破界事変$$ too.」

688:t_3:363.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you think anything is allowed as long as the goal is right, you are dead wrong.」

688:t_3:364.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I will make no excuses. But I want you to know this, at least.」

688:t_3:365.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It is a fact that every one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s, myself and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ included, is working to overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:366.en:
$n
「The names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons... and $$スヴェル$$, too... So what you want is the Ragnarok of Norse mythology...」

688:t_3:367.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's the occult maniac for you! You really get it!」

688:t_3:368.en:
$$ベック$$
「In short, this guy is after the same thing as me.」

688:t_3:369.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Now I understand. You joined the Galactic Raid Fleet to overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:370.en:
$$ベック$$
「Yeah... Reading the last chapter of '$$メトロポリス$$' would make even me feel that way.」

688:t_3:371.en:
$$万丈$$
「The book about the end of the world, written by $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...」

688:t_3:372.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$... Where did you read it?」

688:t_3:373.en:
$$ベック$$
「I met Miss $$エンジェル$$ and she showed it to me. And for what it's worth, the edition I read had its last chapter rewritten.」

688:t_3:375.en:
$$ベック$$
「It was a real letdown, too. Believe it or not, it was a blank page.」

688:t_3:376.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... So that is the future that old man entrusted to us.」

688:t_3:377.en:
$$ベック$$
「Anyway! I have no intention of accepting the existence of a bunch playing god outside the world!」

688:t_3:378.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your mindset is similar to The Edel's. I can understand, to a degree, even the man who refuses to tolerate any being above himself.」

688:t_3:379.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「If you understand, then everything's OK!」

688:t_3:380.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Before that lofty goal, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s have become one like this, beyond position, methods and personality.」

688:t_3:382.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I do think you'll need our power in the battles to come, though...」

688:t_3:383.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The future my late allies entrusted to us... Allow me to fight for it as well.」

688:t_3:389.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You mean the $$ＡＧ$$ costume?」

688:t_3:392.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah~ putting this on does calm the nerves.」

688:t_3:395.en:
$n
「That was $$ブーストアップ$$ and Jeet Kune Do combined. For now, this squares things for your keeping secrets.」

688:t_3:400.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This once, I'll bend my principles too.」

688:t_3:401.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$カレン$$... I'll leave my share to you and $$スザク$$.」

688:t_3:403.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll take care of both shares at once!」

688:t_3:407.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Sorry, $$アレルヤ$$! This one's my turn!」

688:t_3:408.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then I'll represent the $$エレメント$$s!!」

688:t_3:409.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of ours, $$シルヴィア$$.」

688:t_3:411.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it, $$シンジ$$! One punch, no hard feelings afterward, and we end it!」

688:t_3:413.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm leaving it to you, $$ブレラ$$.」

688:t_3:414.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Then I'll go with output at maximum.」

688:t_3:418.en:
$$宗介$$
「Time to wrap this up, I suppose.」

688:t_3:421.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-hey, wait! An Armor Magnum is really out of the question!」

688:t_3:423.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「J-joking...?! Your opponent is $$キリコ$$, you know!」

688:t_3:424.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If I'd meant to kill you, I'd have done it from the start.」

688:t_3:425.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You pulled a trick like $$バインドスペル$$ on us. I'm taking at least this much.」
